summary: Recent updates to the media control features in Firefox focused on handling audio interruptions more effectively. With the new tracking of audio-session interruption state, the browser now better manages when audio playback should pause or resume, especially during events like phone calls or notifications. This also includes enhanced integration tests aimed at **preventing audio from self-starting during these interruptions**, ensuring a smoother and more user-friendly audio experience. These changes matter because they help maintain the continuity of audio playback, offering a more reliable experience for users who rely on audio content while using the browser.
